result.stdout:
cxdbg - ask a running SharpConsoleUI application what it is doing.

Syntax
  cxdbg <verb> [--field value ...] [-s <socket>]

  Field names are the protocol's own, so there is nothing to learn twice.
  A bare --field is true; values are read as numbers, booleans or text.

    cxdbg tree --depth 2
    cxdbg snapshot --format cells --y 7 --h 1
    cxdbg set --logLevel Trace

Starting and attaching
  run <app>               Start an application with a diagnostics socket
  shell                   Open a prompt on a running application

Reading, formatted
  show <verb>             The same verbs, rendered to read
  why size <control>      Which container decided a size, and where
  why color <role>        How a colour was resolved
  send key <spec>         Act on the application the way a user would

Protocol verbs
  snapshot                What the screen shows: text, cells or markup
  image                   What the screen looks like, as a PNG, TGA or JPEG
  tree                    What layout believes: desired against arranged, per control
  desktop                 The screen itself: size, where it starts, what is on it
  control                 What one control is: its size, state, and what contains it
  inspect                 What is under a point: window, region, control, cell
  focus                   What currently has focus, and the chain to it
  reachable               Which controls Tab can reach, in Tab order
  windows                 The windows, their bounds and their state
  metrics                 Render metrics. Needs `set --diagnostics true`
  measure                 Why a control is the size it is
  color                   Why a role is the colour it is
  invalidations           Which control asked for the frame. Needs diagnostics on
  events                  What input the application was told about. Needs diagnostics on
  logs                    The log buffer the application cannot print itself
  frame                   The frame counter - if it stops, so has the app
  set                     Re
